Package index

Input data

Weight and maturity keys, survey indices and catch at age from a pax database, and the model input table.

hr_input_data_lw()
Extract length–weight data from a pax database
hr_input_data_maturity_key()
Estimate maturity-at-length key from survey data
hr_input_data_si_index()
Compute survey index data (abundance and biomass at age)
hr_si_scale_by_strata_stations()
Scale survey abundance to strata using a station list
hr_pool_years()
Pool years for an age-length key
hr_input_data_landings()
Aggregate total landings by year from a pax database
hr_input_data_combine()
Combine survey indices into single input_data
